raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. flag, panji-panji: they marched with ~s flying, mereka berarak dgn panji-panji berkibar; /join, follow/the ~ of, (fig.) menyertai perjuangan; under the ~ of, (fig.) di bawah /bendera, panji-panji/, atas nama: under the ~ of freedom, di bawah bendera kebebasan; 2. large cloth bearing slogan, sepanduk; 3. also banner headline, tajuk besar berita. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
